{
  "schema": "hepta.screen-codec.contract.v1",
  "status": "HOST_BUILT_AND_PURE_CONTRACT_CHECKED_NOT_DEVICE_QUALIFIED",
  "class": "org.trillionnium.hepta.screen.ScreenshotCodec",
  "jar": {
    "path": "/Users/qianqi/Documents/Codex/2026-10-18/pocket4-razr60-ui/work/stock16-hepta-screen-codec-D-v148-r1/build-04/hepta-screen-codec-v148.jar",
    "bytes": 16064,
    "sha256": "bb1176b7707d1a2a67bcfd2bc9bd1b5db16036c3929f8eb1d8820b927ef62639"
  },
  "proposed_phone_path": "/data/local/tmp/hepta-screen-v148-r1/codec.jar",
  "calling_uid": 2000,
  "entry": "CLASSPATH=/data/local/tmp/hepta-screen-v148-r1/codec.jar app_process /system/bin org.trillionnium.hepta.screen.ScreenshotCodec encode --capture-id SAFE --input /data/local/tmp/hepta-shot-SAFE.png --serial ZY22LS7WZT --viewport-before-b64 BASE64_UTF8 --viewport-after-b64 BASE64_UTF8 [--max-bytes N]",
  "arguments": {
    "capture_id": "ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}",
    "input": "Exact/data/local/tmp/hepta-shot-<capture_id>.png; no override or symlink",
    "serial": "Exactly ZY22LS7WZT",
    "metadata": "Each<=6144 UTF8 bytes via strictBase64, one raw line without CR/LF/NUL; original leading spaces preserved",
    "max_bytes": {
      "default": 196608,
      "minimum": 65536,
      "maximum": 196608,
      "canonical_decimal_only": true
    }
  },
  "caller_provenance": [
    "Use actual existing authenticated phone Shell capture, not a host-produced image.",
    "Read full real dumpsys display mViewports line before and after same capture; shell command substitution drops trailing LF only.",
    "Require fresh unique target path not to exist, setumask077, then ordinary Shell screencap physical display4630947043778501779 to that path.",
    "Pass exact raw viewport lines base64; codec parses rather than treating fixed allowlist values as observations.",
    "For model shot do not copy old qualification PNG or forge metadata. A labelled non-model codec qualification may copy an existing real PNG using ordinary Shell cp, without-p orsu.",
    "Caller/provider enforces per-turn total JPEG budget393216B; encoder enforces the requested single-image cap only."
  ],
  "viewport_validation": {
    "same_raw_before_after": true,
    "exactly_one_active_valid_internal": true,
    "logical_display_id": 0,
    "physical_display_id": "local:4630947043778501779",
    "rotation": 0,
    "logical_and_physical_frame": "Rect(0, 0 - 1224, 2992)",
    "device_size": [
      1224,
      2992
    ],
    "other_active_screen_or_rotation": "rejected, not silently remapped"
  },
  "file_validation": [
    "UID/eUID2000 only; all/data,/data/local,/data/local/tmp lstat as real directories",
    "lstat regular Shellowned nlink1,45..16777216 bytes, no group/world write; age-2..60s",
    "open O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, descriptor/stat/path inode/size/mtime/ctime match before/after read",
    "Full bounded read plus EOF, PNG signature/chunk bound/CRC/IHDR1224x2992/IEND structure; no APNG",
    "BitmapFactory bounds and decoded original confirm same real dimensions/MIME",
    "After encoding named source lstat must still match; input file never written/deleted"
  ],
  "encoding": {
    "source_decodes_once": true,
    "max_edges_in_order": [
      1600,
      1280,
      1024,
      800
    ],
    "encoded_sizes_in_order": [
      [
        655,
        1600
      ],
      [
        524,
        1280
      ],
      [
        419,
        1024
      ],
      [
        327,
        800
      ]
    ],
    "jpeg_quality_at_each_size_in_order": [
      80,
      70,
      60,
      50
    ],
    "selection": "First same-image full-frame JPEG<=requested max bytes; no crop, retake, pixel generation or UI action",
    "data": "base64 JPEG; sha256 of exact encoded bytes and original full PNG bytes",
    "bitmap_release": "All scaled bitmaps and original recycled in finally",
    "mainLooper": "Prepare only if both processmainLooper and threadLooper absent; no loop/thread/UI service"
  },
  "success": {
    "rc": 0,
    "schema": "hepta.phone-screenshot.v1",
    "status": "encoded",
    "media_type": "image/jpeg",
    "encoding": "base64",
    "exact_keys": [
      "schema",
      "status",
      "capture_id",
      "serial",
      "logical_display_id",
      "physical_display_id",
      "rotation",
      "viewport_before",
      "viewport_after",
      "original_width",
      "original_height",
      "encoded_width",
      "encoded_height",
      "media_type",
      "encoding",
      "quality",
      "data_base64",
      "image_sha256",
      "source_png_sha256",
      "source_png_bytes",
      "encoded_bytes"
    ],
    "no_max_bytes_extra_key": true
  },
  "failure": {
    "rc": [
      20,
      22
    ],
    "keys": [
      "schema",
      "status",
      "reason"
    ],
    "schema": "hepta.phone-screenshot.v1",
    "status": "rejected",
    "no_data_or_stack_trace": true
  },
  "coordinate_contract": "Model coordinates from encoded image need per-axis original_width/encoded_width and original_height/encoded_height mapping before input. Current viewport must still equal encoded viewport guard; encoder does not inject any touch.",
  "effects_by_encoder": {
    "screen_capture": false,
    "network": false,
    "filesystem_writes": false,
    "chmod_or_permissions": false,
    "IME_or_a11y_connection": false,
    "UI_actions": false,
    "additional_processes": false
  },
  "limits": [
    "Host pure contract tests do not execute Android Bitmap/Os runtime. Root must perform actual codec qualification and separate actual model screenshot->image->action tests.",
    "Old D8/API34 tool emits min-api36 unsupported warning; code calls publicAPI<=34 only.",
    "Encoder validates supplied viewport observations but does not itself authenticate/capture them; caller Host command/provenance is required."
  ]
}
